fields.title: Choosing a first robot toy for a three-year-old
fields.description: Age grade, batteries and safety certificates: what to check before you buy a first robot, with the Walking Robot Buddy as the example.
fields.body:
*Tumbleberry Toys is a fictional demo store, and this is a sample post: it shows how the shop's blog works. Archive it when you open your own shop.*

A first robot should do a few things well and be safe to hand to a small child. Here is what to look at, with our [Walking Robot Buddy](/products/tt-walking-robot) as the example.

## Is it made for the child's age?

Look for the age grade on the box and on the product page. Walking Robot Buddy is graded **3+**: rounded edges and no small parts.

## How is it powered?

It takes **2 × AA batteries, which are not included**. The battery door closes with a screw, so a child cannot open it.

## Which safety certificates are on file?

Every product page lists the certificates we hold and the date until which each one is valid. For this robot: EN 71, ASTM F963, CPSIA / CPC and UKCA.

## The facts in one place

| | Walking Robot Buddy |
| --- | --- |
| Price | $24.00 |
| Age | 3+ |
| Batteries | 2 × AA (not included) |
| Size | 14 × 9 × 21 cm |
| Warranty | 1-year limited warranty |
| Returns | 30-day returns |

Shipping is added at checkout for your country, before you pay: see [Shipping costs and delivery times, by country](/blog/shipping-costs-and-delivery-times).

## When does my parcel leave?

We ship from our warehouse within 5 working days after payment. The delivery time above starts when the parcel leaves.

## My country is not in the list

Then checkout cannot ship to it yet. Write to us before you order: our address is on the [Contact](/pages/contact) page.
